_about: Speech settings shared by every machine. Put this machine's own values in server/settings.local.json (git-ignored); it is laid over this file.
_models_dir: The folder holding the Whisper model. When AiHub starts Speech it gives its own (the SoundModels folder), which wins.
_model: The Whisper model folder (MLX format) in models_dir, for example whisper-large-v3-turbo from mlx-community.
_language: The language spoken, as a code like "en". Empty = Whisper works it out (a little slower, can guess wrong on very short clips).
_unload_after_minutes: Let go of the model (about 1.6 GB) when nothing has been said for this long. The next time loads it again (a few seconds).
